desc.short: 交叉冲洗风格曲线族：通道曲线交叉 + 染料雾交叉曝光，青蓝阴影、黄绿高光的反转负冲质感。

params.preset: 风格预设：经典（青蓝阴影 / 黄绿高光）、绿偏移（病感绿中间调）、暖调（琥珀暖色、蓝色漂白）。
params.strength: 整体效果混合量，0 时完全直通；经感知曲线整形，滑杆手感线性。

desc.short: Cross-process look family: crossed per-channel curves plus dye-fog crosstalk for cyan-blue shadows and yellow-green highlights.

params.preset: Look preset: Classic (cyan-blue shadows / yellow-green highlights), Green Shift (sickly green mids), Warm (amber cast, bleached blues).
params.strength: Overall effect mix, 0 is a full bypass; perceptually shaped slider.
